menu:Tools/Sample bundle hello: The editor never loads the sample bundle (main.tsx loads bundles through plugin-sdk's loadBundle; the shell's worker loader and sampleBundleManifest() have no caller), so no Playwright session has a Tools menu item to open. The registration itself (path, command, order) is asserted through the shell's loader in packages/shell/test/bundles/sample-bundle.test.ts, along with SH-13 (the manifest declares the path with different capitals). Possible once the app loads the sample in a dev build; deleting the sample removes the entry.
